## Product Review

`rating` (1-5), `body`, links to `plan` or `service`. Deliberately NOT rendered inside RevenueOs (an internal sales-ops console, not a public review surface) — instead self-hosted by `plan.gts`/`service.gts`'s own isolated views, which is a real consumer without forcing the wrong UI into the wrong app. This is the least load-bearing of the 18 concepts — nothing else depends on it.

### Non-goals
Does not verify purchase authenticity in this pass (an optional `verifiedPurchase` linksTo Order is a Should-Have, not built here). Does not aggregate ratings into a Plan-level average — that would be a live-query rollup, deferred.

### Example
`linkedExamples` points at `ProductReview/enterprise-tier-review`, linked to the real `Plan/enterprise-tier` instance.
attributes.cardDescription: Customer feedback tied to a Plan or Service, not to a specific purchase — public-facing, like a review site.
